GATE RUSH 1.5.0 - P3 ESCORT: WHAT WAS BUILT, THE CONTRACTS, NOTES FOR P4
==========================================================================
Branch r9/P3 (worktree E:/Temp/claude/r9wt/P3) on r9-150 7d813c2. ESCORT plays only with ?debug=1&type=escort until P4 sets
LEVEL_TYPES.escort.enabled (and nightEscort stays off: combos false).

FILES
- js/escortgen.js (new, pure: util + data; imported only by levelgen). escortParams(L), escortBuild(run, L, seed, aux) -> { script, ok, stats },
  escortRunPart(script) (tools: the run the escort was built on).
- js/escort.js (new): EscortSystem, ctx.escort, a ModeSystem with keepsRun = true.
- js/levelgen.js: escortSteps in BASE_STEPS (generateRunSteps with ESCORT_GEN.run.fixed {lim 99, win 99} and escortgen's idle rule as
  the C11 check, then escortBuild on the best run), export escortAux(script, L, c) (the design line's lane per gate + the fixed lines'
  squad samples at the expected shop and rank 10; escortgen is pure and cannot run levelgen's model itself).
- js/zombies.js: setContactProvider(p) (tested first in _contact; answers C_ATTACH / C_CRUSH / C_HOLD / C_BRUTE / C_BUMPER), attach(id, slot),
  detach(id, cause), F_ATTACHED (position from p.slotPos, still in the z-bins so rounds hit it), _climb[] (spawned by a wave with
  truck: true), drawn height _y[] (0 unless attached), causes 'grab' and 'bumper' pay no coins. All no-ops with no provider; a level
  start clears it.
- js/weapons.js: setTracerClip(x0, x1, z) (cosmetic; NaN off; a level start clears it). The PLAN said fx; the tracers are drawn by
  weapons, so the clip lives there.
- js/models.js: 'survivor' character class (CHARACTER_CLASSES, shares the 'gr:char' program), geo.escortTruck / escortWheels /
  escortPlate / escortCheckpoint / escortSafe, ModelLibrary.buildRescueTruck() (body, wheels, lights, blinkL, blinkR).
- js/main.js: SYSTEMS + ctx.escort; js/engine.js: escort.step after hold, escort.render after hold; js/level.js: RESET_ORDER + 'escort'.
- js/ui.js: _copyFailed keeps base; _fillGameover titles a typed loss from STRINGS.types.results[base].causes[cause] (TRUCK OVERRUN);
  fix pass: a type with its own results tip shows it on any loss with input (f.idle false), RS.steer only on a no-input loss.
- Follow decisions (fix pass): the truck changes lanes between gates, so a guard logs no gate decision there. escort._stepFollow opens a
  window at the start (ESCORT.follow.firstS) and at each change (its blinkers to its end + graceS); a window is decided once
  input.targetX travelled assist.minTravelM in it and sits within follow.tolM of the truck's lane, and reports level.addActivity(1, 0)
  (a decision, no event: the share stays a share of gates). Held lines / no input never travel, so they still build no streak.
- js/data.js: ESCORT / ESCORT_GEN / ESCORT_TEXT / ESCORT_AUDIO region; LEVEL_TYPES.escort / nightEscort starThree 0.85; TYPES_TEXT:
  brief.escort, results.escort { title, bonus, bonusMode 'Delivered', score, causes.truck, tip }, codex row 'type.escort' (+ its id in
  the types section). Field Guide section 'escort' (truck, climbers, plates, checkpoint), marked by escort.js (save 'seen:<id>').
- css/game.css: ESCORT region (.tt-truck badge). sw.js PRECACHE + index.html modulepreload: escort.js, escortgen.js (artifact.html is
  regenerated by tools/build-artifact.js at release: P4).
- tools/escortsim.js (new), tools/validate-levels.js (escort branch: the run part as a level + E1/E4 + rebuild equality + checkpoint).

THE SCRIPT
- One { type: 'escort', at: 1, spec } event = script.finale 'escort' (C1: begins at 1 m, the run goes on). spec: L, T, start, board,
  plates, plateHp, grab, side0, changes [{ at, to, s }], checkpoint, gauntlet, safeZone (the distance where the truck reaches the gate =
  script.length), brutes, debut, run { length, runup, boss } (what the escort replaced).
- Climber waves: one per run wave, { type: 'wave', pattern: 'line', x: the truck's x where they reach it, units { walker (+ brute every
  3rd brute wave from L28) }, hp, truck: true } - EXTRA walkers (climberShare of the wave's population), the run's waves untouched, so
  the gate maths and the squad's model hold. HP = climberHpE (0.3) x E(contact) for a walker. Only these climb: any other zombie that
  touches the truck dies under its bumper (cause 'bumper', no coins), so the truck shields a squad behind it.
- The run-up is rewritten as the gauntlet (round((15 + L) x 1.5) capped 60, HP solved at run time) + K climber bursts; the safe zone is
  tailS after the last burst reaches the truck. Base 'escort', eTarget T = ESCORT.survivorsOf(L), starMetric 'delivered'.
- Lane changes: a gap between gates k and k + 1 starts gapM after the tailgate passes gate k (waveM after that gap's climbers reach the
  truck) and ends armedM before gate k + 1 is armed; no climber reaches the truck inside a change. A route search (160 candidates)
  balances the truck mass between the sides (E4), keeps the opener aligned and aims at splitShare. From L48 a feint (out and back).

THE IDLE RULE (E1 / E4, PLAN C10 / C11) - conservative, HP-free
- For each fixed line (x 0, -2.1, +2.1) at both shops: a climber is safe if a formation column (half-width at the line's modelled count
  + 0.5 m) reaches its spawn x or its rail; the rest queue on their rail (3 slots a side, grab + slide per climb) and those that grab
  before the safe zone are losses; minus every plate used perfectly (start + checkpoint + 3 assist) x (plateHp + 1). Must be >= 1.3 T.
  E4: each side holds >= 45 % of the climber mass. Repair: + 0.08 climber share on the waves the failing line leaves uncovered (<= 0.75),
  8 passes; else the attempt fails (+1000) and the loop re-rolls to the long budget.

RUNTIME RULES (escort.js)
- Slots: a climber takes the first slot of its side (by contact x) from the nose back that is not taken; a plate there knocks it off
  (a hit, 'crush', coins); all taken, it waits (C_HOLD). Grab ring (fx 'ring' decal) fills and rides with the truck; at grab s the
  climber leaps off ('grab') with a survivor. 0 survivors = finish(false, 'truck').
- PLATE (hud:action, one press one plate): the fullest gauge's climber knocked off and its slot plated; else the free slot facing more
  zombies ahead. Stock: 2 at the debut, 1 after; +1 at the checkpoint; +1 per REINFORCEMENTS step (C10). stat.presses counts them (C14).
- Brutes (climber brutes only): hold the nose and swing (zombies' APC rule); a front plate takes 2 hits; from L28 with no front plate a
  swing takes a survivor.
- Clear: stat.bonus = perSurvivorL x L x delivered (the Delivered chip), stat.score = 150 x delivered + 500 with no loss.

CUTS (PLAN cut order, budget): L34 truck hunters (cut 1) and the threat-band tint (cut 2, never built). The L48 feint stays.
Not built per C3 / C6: first-meeting ease, rescue gates, spitters at the truck, night escort.

NOTES FOR P4
- Enable: LEVEL_TYPES.escort.enabled = true. eTargetOf already returns ESCORT.survivorsOf(L); validate-levels handles base 'escort'.
- The brief shows only when the level's stage type is escort (not with ?type=); its goal line is the generic "★★★ at N survivors".
- Pay (design bot, expected shop): L18 escort 1538-2699 vs standard L17-19 greedy 1233-2232; L28 2212-3668 vs 1779-2688 (pre-final; the
  final rows are in final/pay-std.jsonl and final/skill-exp.jsonl).
- package --lint and the size table: see PROGRESS.txt.
